_readme: Part names for autocomplete in Add part. One array per kind: BLADE, RATCHET, BIT, LOCK_CHIP, MAIN_BLADE, ASSIST_BLADE, METAL_BLADE, OVER_BLADE. Each entry: name (required), code (ratchet like 9-60, bit like GF, assist blade letter like S, over blade letter like B), type (ATTACK, DEFENSE, STAMINA or BALANCE, blades, main blades and metal blades only), leftSpin (true or false), builtInRatchet (true on blades with an integrated ratchet, e.g. Bullet Griffon, whose combo has no ratchet: "Bullet Griffon H"), builtInBit (true on RATCHET entries that include the bit, e.g. Turbo "Tr", whose combo has no separate bit: "Pegasus Blast ATr"). CX combos use either a MAIN_BLADE or a METAL_BLADE + OVER_BLADE (Expand Blade), never both; Expand Blade combo order is Lock Chip + Metal Blade, then Over Blade code, Assist Blade code, ratchet, bit, e.g. "Bahamut Blitz BK1-50I". Example entry: {"name": "Example Blade", "type": "ATTACK"}. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Rebuild the app after editing. PRODUCTS: Takara Tomy Beyblade X products (BX-xx, UX-xx, CX-xx and BX-00/UX-00/CX-00 specials) that contain at least one Bey, sorted by code (BX, UX, CX, numerically; specials by release date). Each product: code, name (English name as the Beyblade Wiki lists it), released (ISO date, omitted if unknown), kind (STARTER, BOOSTER, RANDOM_BOOSTER, SET, DECK_SET or OTHER), builds. Each build is one stock Bey in the box (random boosters list every possible Bey): combo (official stock combo name, spaced like the part names), shape (BASIC = Blade + Ratchet + Bit; CX = Lock Chip + Main Blade + Assist Blade + Ratchet + Bit; CX_METAL = Lock Chip + Metal Blade + Over Blade + Assist Blade + Ratchet + Bit; no RATCHET part for builtInRatchet blades, no BIT part for builtInBit ratchets), type (ATTACK, DEFENSE, STAMINA or BALANCE, omitted if unclear), parts. Each part: kind (a part array name above), name (matches an entry of that kind, case-insensitive), code (bits, assist blades and over blades only). Launchers, stadiums, single-part prizes and loose parts in Customize Sets are not listed. hasbro (optional, part entries and PRODUCTS builds): the Hasbro name when the Beyblade Wiki gives a different one for the same part or the same stock combo (e.g. Mummy Curse = "Curse Mummy", Horus Shatter = "Shatter Horus", Dran Sword 3-60F = "Sword Dran 3-60F"); search should match it too, but name stays the Takara Tomy name. Hasbro-only parts and products are not listed.
